claims.claim: BEAM-302 showed up to 18 months of durability after a single dose, with increased total and functional AAT and reduced mutant Z-AAT; dosing is underway in a global pivotal cohort intended to support potential U.S. accelerated approval.

risks.risk: Early clinical durability and biomarker correction do not establish pivotal efficacy, regulatory approval, commercial uptake or long-term safety.

unknowns.unknown: Pivotal cohort enrollment pace, final regulatory path, label breadth and commercial economics remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Beam has advanced BEAM-302 from Phase 1/2 evidence into dosing of a global pivotal cohort while also appointing a chief commercial officer, indicating organizational preparation for later-stage development and potential launches.

risks.risk: Commercial build-out ahead of approval raises fixed-cost and execution exposure if clinical or regulatory milestones slip.

unknowns.unknown: Cash runway after current pivotal and launch-preparation spending and milestone timing were not established here.
